name: a writer admits without checking the gate under the lock
replace:
/\ CASE replay = "caughtUp" ->
                      /\ holder' = w

/\ CASE TRUE ->
                      /\ holder' = w

name: replay steps while a writer holds the lock
replace: Step == /\ holder = "free" /\ StepReady
Step == /\ StepReady

name: a step that fails outside an apply refuses its op
replace:
/\ replay' = "waitRetry" /\ failed' = TRUE
                       /\ UNCHANGED <<todo, applied, refused>>

/\ refused' = refused \cup {op} /\ todo' = Tail(todo)
                       /\ UNCHANGED <<replay, failed, applied>>

name: an apply error of unknown kind waits to retry
replace:
[] op = "bad" ->
                       /\ refused' = refused \cup {op} /\ todo' = Tail(todo)
                       /\ replay' = Next1
                       /\ UNCHANGED <<failed, applied>>

[] op = "bad" ->
                       /\ replay' = "waitRetry"
                       /\ UNCHANGED <<todo, failed, applied, refused>>

name: an apply error of unknown kind drops its op unrecorded
replace:
[] op = "bad" ->
                       /\ refused' = refused \cup {op} /\ todo' = Tail(todo)
                       /\ replay' = Next1
                       /\ UNCHANGED <<failed, applied>>

[] op = "bad" ->
                       /\ todo' = Tail(todo)
                       /\ replay' = Next1
                       /\ UNCHANGED <<failed, applied, refused>>

name: a gap waits as a missing handler
replace: /\ replay' = "waitGap"
/\ replay' = "waitHandler"

name: a write during opening is admitted before caughtUp
replace:
/\ CASE replay = "caughtUp" ->
                      /\ holder' = w

/\ CASE replay \in {"opening", "caughtUp"} ->
                      /\ holder' = w

name: a handler wait is never resumed
replace: \/ replay = "waitHandler" /\ Seen

name: a write refused or cancelled never tries again
replace: Retry(w) == /\ wstate[w] \in {"refused", "cancelled"} /\ Writable
Retry(w) == /\ wstate[w] \in {"refused", "cancelled"} /\ FALSE

name: a waiting write is refused when replay catches up
replace:
THEN /\ holder' = w /\ wstate' = [wstate EXCEPT ![w] = "checked"]
              ELSE

THEN /\ UNCHANGED holder /\ wstate' = [wstate EXCEPT ![w] = "refused"]
              ELSE

name: a waiting write is never woken
replace: Wake(w) == /\ wstate[w] = "waiting" /\ replay # "opening" /\ holder = "free"
Wake(w) == /\ wstate[w] = "waiting" /\ FALSE /\ holder = "free"

name: an opening with nothing left to apply stays opening
replace:
THEN /\ replay' = "caughtUp"
           THEN /\ replay' = replay

name: a restart forgets the ops it applied
replace: /\ todo' = SelectSeq(log, LAMBDA o : o \in applied \cup refused) \o todo
/\ todo' = todo

name: an owner's skip never wakes a waiting replay
replace: \/ replay \in Waits /\ Head(todo) \in skipped

name: replay applies a skipped op
replace:
IF op \in skipped
                IF FALSE

name: a skip refuses its op only until a restart
replace:
IF op \in skipped
                IF op \in skipped /\ ~restarted

name: an unreadable body is refused as an unknown operation type
replace:
[] op = "newer" /\ ~upgraded ->
                       /\ replay' = "waitUpgrade"
                       /\ UNCHANGED <<todo, failed, applied, refused>>

[] op = "newer" /\ ~upgraded ->
                       /\ refused' = refused \cup {op} /\ todo' = Tail(todo)
                       /\ replay' = Next1
                       /\ UNCHANGED <<failed, applied>>

name: replay applies the op after an unreadable body and keeps waiting at it
replace:
[] op = "newer" /\ ~upgraded ->
                       /\ replay' = "waitUpgrade"
                       /\ UNCHANGED <<todo, failed, applied, refused>>

[] op = "newer" /\ ~upgraded /\ Len(todo) > 1 ->
                       /\ applied' = applied \cup {todo[2]}
                       /\ todo' = <<"newer">> \o SubSeq(todo, 3, Len(todo))
                       /\ replay' = "waitUpgrade"
                       /\ UNCHANGED <<failed, refused>>
                  [] op = "newer" /\ ~upgraded ->
                       /\ replay' = "waitUpgrade"
                       /\ UNCHANGED <<todo, failed, applied, refused>>

name: an unreadable body waits as a gap
replace:
[] op = "newer" /\ ~upgraded ->
                       /\ replay' = "waitUpgrade"
                       /\ UNCHANGED <<todo, failed, applied, refused>>

[] op = "newer" /\ ~upgraded ->
                       /\ replay' = "waitGap"
                       /\ UNCHANGED <<todo, failed, applied, refused>>

name: a restart on a newer build keeps the upgrade wait
replace:
/\ upgraded' = (upgraded \/ Upgrades)
           /\ upgraded' = upgraded

name: an owner's skip never ends an upgrade wait
replace: Skip == /\ OwnerSkips /\ replay \in Waits /\ Head(todo) \notin skipped
Skip == /\ OwnerSkips /\ replay \in Waits \ {"waitUpgrade"} /\ Head(todo) \notin skipped
